description: Prints ele's notes block, shows any pending handoff and active plan to the user too, and starts a background sync when a session starts, clears or compacts. Not on resume: as of 2026-10-15 a resumed transcript already holds the block. Syncs in the background again when a session ends. When a turn ends, asks for notes once per stretch of work between checkpoints, and suggests /compact or a handoff past 150k of context. When a turn ends with files changed and a done claim but no checkpoint reported, blocks once for ele:checkpoint; each prompt snapshots the working tree that block compares against. Both checkpoint hooks do nothing when ele config get checkpoint_gate prints false. The Stop hook turns any stop-check failure into exit 1: as of 2026-10-19 a Stop hook's exit 2 keeps the turn from ending, and an ele built before stop-check exits 2 on it.
